Global AI and Chip Stocks Extend Losses Amid Rate and Debt Concerns

Global technology hardware stocks, particularly in the AI and chip sectors, continued their decline on Thursday. Asian chipmakers followed a downward trend set by their US counterparts, driven by concerns over potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve and difficulties in AI funding. This sell-off has led to a deepening rout in global AI stocks, with Asian markets experiencing a significant tumble.
